title: 4521-ESP-AGE-39-45-0001 R2
summary:
- This document is an engineering specification for a project named Solana.
- It outlines the scope of work, including supply of instruments and related materials.
- The specification includes definitions for key terms such as Supplier, Customer, Fabricator, and Owner.
- Supplier is responsible for delivering material to designated locations and tracking all purchased items.
- There are exclusions from this subcontract, and a single contact person must be provided by the Supplier.
